plan: The goal is to maximize profit. Since I pay the second-highest bid, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy in a second-price auction. This ensures that I win only when my value is greater than what I pay, and I never lose profit by overbidding. I will bid my value of $31.

I will bid slightly above my value to maximize my chances of winning while still ensuring a profit. Given my value is $37, I will bid $37.1 to outbid anyone who bids exactly their value. This strategy aims to secure the win and profit, as I only pay the second-highest bid.

This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a second-price payment rule (Vickrey auction). In such auctions, the dominant strategy for a rational bidder is to bid their true value. This strategy maximizes expected utility regardless of the other bidders' strategies. Since I want to maximize my profit in the long run, and the values are redrawn independently, bidding my true value is the optimal strategy for this round.
